title: lifelike
description: I wanted to start off the album with the simplest and most fundamental possible sounds, which is that “sample pop” and then the sound of the piano. There's this idea of a “window” or a “portal” that appears a lot in the nurture art../ I think of lifelike as kind of serving that purpose on the album. A little portal into the worldview.
author: — Porter Robinson

title: look at the sky
description: I sat on that opening hook since like 2016 and but I only really made progress on the songwriting in 2018 when Rika and I took a trip to Japan and I worked out of a studio there for a few weeks. That inspired me so much
author: — Porter Robinson

title: get your wish
description: MY ABSOLUTE FAVORITE THING ABOUT THIS SONG IS HOW IT GOES FROM NON-SWINGY TO SWINGY HALFWAY THROUGH THE CHORUS
author: — Porter Robinson

title: wind tempos
description: Takagi Masakatsu gave me this USB full of japanese ambient music I didn't know from the early 2000s, and he said he thought I would really love it based on my music that I had showed him I listened to and love that music and that's what drove me to dive into Wind Tempos -- ultimately I included like a 0.5 second long sample of him playing the toy piano from while we were at his home, just as a little wax seal to close the love letter
author: — Porter Robinson

title: musician
description: The laser beam loops in musician were 100% inspired by “Someone to Call my Lover” by Janet JAckson. Absolutely amazing song
author: — Porter Robinson

title: do-re-mi-fa-so-la-ti-do
description: one interesting thing is that a lot of people tend to hear their own language in the little “children at the playground” foley samples in do-re-mi -- I hear “wait up” and people in japan have been hearing “ohaiyo” -- it's actually neither of those languages.
author: — Porter Robinson

title: mother
description: I really really cherish the lyrics in the second verse of mother -- “and I've known the feeling you had when you're helped/held the comfort of being unwell so something can cradle you”. I LOVE YOU MOM
author: — Porter Robinson

title: dullscythe
description: this started off as an interlude idea, but once I had the idea to put huge drums synchronized them to these arhythmic chops I got so so excited
author: — Porter Robinson

title: sweet time
description: “Since i met you i don't wanna die no more ” -- there were times I worried this lyric was too direct, but I couldnt get away from it. That little metallic sound into the piano solo is RIKA HERSELF going “PREE!!” layered with like a bell sound or something lol
author: — Porter Robinson

title: mirror
description: I truly feel like this song is the biggest “grower” on the album, the chorus progression and vocal melody are so long but really satisfying once you have it in memory. I really REALLY wanted to be completely free of shame and fear of what others will think while writing Mirror. getting closer to that. I thought that being able to predict the negative things people will think and say about you, and changing yourself to accomodate that, was a virtue for a long time.
author: — Porter Robinson
